sourceRequest: Forge 12개 플레이어 행동 제한 안에서 건설·확장과 먹기·휴식을 결합해 탈출 행동을 보존한다.

art.note: Contextual prompt and module-expansion visual kits are review-only. No candidate is adopted, packaged, or runtime-connected pending explicit user selection.

implementation.note: Spatial camp interaction, one-room module expansion, ko/en plus non-shipping qps-long, Korean 1280 HUD fit, and the complete survival loop are integrated.

verification.note: Automated product and infrastructure gates pass with no expected product gaps. User playtest and physical gamepad actuation remain outstanding; Steam release work remains out of scope.
